thread_title: senior mobile plans - which telco have best package?
post_text:
For Seniors, it is not good to have bill shock due to extra charges on top of monthly subscription charges.
1. SingTel MNO Senior plan: high Pay per Use roaming voice charges and roaming outgoing SMS charges. There will be extra roaming data charges as well even with ReadyRoam add-on. Without ReadyRoam, pay per use roaming data will be even higher.
2. Starhub MNO Senior plan: no extra charges.
Free roaming voice.
Free roaming SMS.
3. M1 MNO Senior plans: high Pay per Use roaming voice charges and roaming outgoing SMS charges. There will be extra roaming data charges even with M1 Data Passport.
Called ID is not free.
4. SIMBA MNO Senior plan: high excess roaming data charges. Also got charges for excess local calls, local SMS and IDD calls.
Free roaming voice.
5.SingTel Gomo Senior Plan: no extra charges.
No roaming voice support.
6. SingTel hi! Senior Plan: no extra charges
No roaming voice support.
7.Starhub eight Senior Plan: no extra charges.
Free roaming voice.
8. CL Senior Plan (not good for roaming): high pay as you roam data charges, high pay as you roam roaming incoming/outgoing voice and outgoing roaming SMS charges. Roaming must be manually enabled via the Circles.Life App to avoid accidental background charges.
